tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Look up the status of a Docracy signing chain from a sign or status link — who's signed, who's still pending.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List free and Marketplace legal templates from Docracy (NDAs, contractor agreements, offer letters, etc.). Optional text filter. Returns slugs and prepare URLs — does not create or send documents.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Fetch metadata for one Docracy template by slug (title, description, key clauses / drafting hints when available) plus the prepare URL to open it for e-signature.

tools.name: draft_from_template
tools.description: Start an agentic drafting workflow from a trusted Docracy template. Returns the prepare URL (fields already placed where applicable), library page, and drafting hints. Does NOT auto-send for signature — the human reviews and sends on docracy.io. Optional notes are echoed as a drafting brief for the

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_templates, get_template · Private data: list_templates · Public sink: list_templates, draft_from_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_templates, get_template · Private data: list_templates · Public sink: list_templates, draft_from_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
